notes: Route is driver-gap: no driver in the repo (nor the shared drive-interactive.sh.tmpl scaffold) has a seed_instruction/file/write primitive yet -- five cells wait on it (codex, copilot, muse, opencode, pi), all targeting the same AGENTS.md filename, so it should be designed once in the shared template rather than per-driver. Muse loads a persistent AGENTS.md project-rules file at session start, verbatim, wrapped in a <rules-file scope="" written-for="Muse Code..."> tag inside a <system-reminder source="rules-file"> block (confirmed via `strings` on the installed muse-bin-1.2.1-R2847.1 binary, and independently corroborated by the live corpus's context_block_diagnostic{block_id:"rules_file",source:"rules_file",lifecycle:"session_start"} bookkeeping, muse-format-spec.md section 11), so a marker rule seeded into that file should reach the model the same way a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rule reaches claudecode/codex. Once emitted, session metrics should carry task_estimate {total_rounds:4, completed_rounds:M} matching the marker (completed_rounds<=total_rounds), updated_at advancing on each fresher marker, completed_rounds non-decreasing and reaching 4 on the final working turn, task_completion_eta present once completed_rounds>=1 and burning down (later eta <= earlier), and both fields absent at ready (suppressed-by-state). These metric assertions are NOT expressible in the phase DSL (cf. muse/basic-turn spec); they belong in the recipe verify[] once recorded. DAEMON FIX LANDED (10e0c6554): muse's parseAssistantMessageCommitted (core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/parser.go:675-687) now calls tailer.ScanTaskEstimate on the full un-truncated assistant text and sets ev.TaskEstimate BEFORE truncating into ev.AssistantText, satisfying TruncateAssistantText's documented contract (core/pkg/tailer/parser.go: "Adapters MUST scan the full text for markers (ScanTaskEstimate) BEFORE calling this") -- the identical shape commit 1ae457d9 fixed for codex/pi/aider/opencode. Red-first test TestParseLine_AssistantMessageCommitted_TaskEstimate_SurvivesTruncation confirmed PASS against the post-fix parser. So task_estimate/task_completion_eta CAN now surface for muse once this cell actually records -- the only remaining blocker is the driver-side seed_instruction primitive, not the daemon. The phases below assert only the user-observable STATE arc the marker would ride on (ready->working->ready), single-birth per muse's session model (no ProcessMatcher/presession split -- muse-format-spec.md section 1, and replaydata/agents/muse/scenarios/2-1_basic-turn/expected.jsonl's committed precedent).
source: replaydata/agents/codex/scenarios/5-8_task-estimate-marker -> Feature: Task estimate marker (adapted for muse's single-birth session model + AGENTS.md rules_file loading)

text: Session appears in ready shortly after the muse TUI finishes launching (AGENTS.md with the marker rule already seeded into the fresh per-run cwd before muse starts)
muse-bin PID bound via the session's .session.lock held flock fd

First prompt opens the 4-phase task -> working; muse should emit the initial marker (completed_rounds=0, total_rounds=4) per the seeded AGENTS.md rule and task_estimate should appear on the session metrics while working

Across the 'next' turns completed_rounds should climb non-decreasing to 4 and task_completion_eta should burn down; the final working turn reports the task done, then the session settles back to ready where task_estimate / task_completion_eta are absent (suppressed-by-state)
exit_clean's graceful /exit ends the session -- process_exited on the session
